scope: Read-only feasibility check using preserved C7 OFF/COUPLED history through T180; no model run, proxy flux calculation, or continuity closure claim.

available_history_fields.COUPLED: Same names and shapes as OFF. Exact cross-arm geometry matches are recorded in history_180s.json.

native_equation_reference.equation_as_expressed_in_source: dvdxi = MAPFAC_MX*MAPFAC_MY * [rdy*Delta_y(V + (C1H*MUV+C2H)*V_1*MF_VX_INV) + rdx*Delta_x(U + (C1H*MUU+C2H)*U_1/MAPFAC_UY)]; DMDT = sum_k DNW(k)*dvdxi; MU update = MU + dts*(DMDT+MU_TEND).
native_equation_reference.identity_to_frozen_C7_compiled_source: NOT ESTABLISHED. The C7 native build receipt binds parent archive libwrflib_pr85.a SHA-256 102faf532e0d0cb361e8cf0ce2098224c0b7ef09aaa008cf4a421e1584059911 and links module_small_step_em.o from that archive. Its receipt does not bind that object's source file hash to the currently checked-out module_small_step_em.F above. The checked-out file is used only as an equation reference; source equivalence to the frozen compiled object is not claimed.

missing_history_fields_for_exact_native_.role: Previous RK/fast-step U state in native mass tendency
Previous RK/fast-step V state in native mass tendency
Additional mass tendency combined with horizontal divergence
History is sampled every 60 seconds while the model step is 20 seconds; intermediate stage values and time-level context are not retained.

decision.endpoint_native_flux_reconstruction: NOT FEASIBLE from retained history alone
decision.full_continuity_closure: NOT ESTABLISHED; two endpoints are insufficient, and current history has only four 60-second states without native stage tendencies
decision.cloudbal_tool_reuse: tools/cp06a_state_force_flux.py implements a pressure-coordinate state-flux diagnostic with different interpolation/geometry. It is not the native eta-coordinate advance_mu_t operator and is not used to report native continuity here.
